Registering & Logging In

JWTs, the two public routes that issue them, and two deliberate security decisions hiding inside otherwise-ordinary CRUD-shaped code.

  • What Is a JWT?

    A signed, self-contained ticket a client carries with every request — instead of a session Laravel keeps on the server.

  • Signing and Verifying Tokens

    utils/jwt.js wraps jsonwebtoken; env.js's Zod schema grows a new required field to make it possible at all.

  • Register: Always a Customer

    The one field this endpoint deliberately never reads from the request body is the role it creates.

  • Login: One Message for Two Failures

    "No such user" and "wrong password" are different bugs, but the exact same response — on purpose.
